name: Christopher Saenz
office: City of Baldwin Park, City Clerk

items.text: Christopher Saenz is the elected city clerk of Baldwin Park, a position he has held since 2022. Before serving as clerk, he was a member of the city's Planning Commission.

sentences.text: Christopher Saenz is the elected city clerk of Baldwin Park, a position he has held since 2022.
Before serving as clerk, he was a member of the city's Planning Commission.

items.text: His official city biography states he is committed to increasing transparency and civic involvement.
